title: COVID-19 SCAN Molecular Workflow
author: Lea Starita
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bebkjakw
materials: Aliquot samples from the original upper respiratory sample found in Universal Transport Medium and transfer into barcoded matrix tubes (Thermo).
Extract total nucleic acids using the Magna Pure 96 automated extractor using the DNA and Viral NA Small Volume Kit (Roche).

steps.title: Transfer sample to extraction plate
steps.instruction: Transfer 200 µL of the sample to the extraction plate and store the remaining sample at –80 °C.

steps.title: Keep extracted nucleic acids on ice
steps.instruction: Place the extracted nucleic acids on ice and keep them there for the remainder of the protocol.

steps.title: Dispense S‑target master mix
steps.instruction: Using a Mantis liquid dispenser (Formulatrix) inside a dead‑air hood, dispense the S‑target master mix into rows A, C, E, G, I, K, M and O of the 384‑well plate.

substeps.instruction: Load master mix into rows A, C, E, G, I, K, M, O with the dispenser.
Master mix composition: 1× TaqPath 1‑step RT‑qPCR master mix (catalog A15300); 1× SARS‑CoV‑2 assay with FAM fluor (4332079, assay # APXGVC4); 1× RNaseP assay with VIC fluor (catalog A30064).

steps.title: Dispense Orf1B‑target master mix
steps.instruction: Using a Mantis liquid dispenser (Formulatrix) inside a dead‑air hood, dispense the Orf1B‑target master mix into rows B, D, F, H, J, L, N and P of the 384‑well plate.

substeps.instruction: Load master mix into rows B, D, F, H, J, L, N, P with the dispenser.
Master mix composition: 1× TaqPath 1‑step RT‑qPCR master mix (catalog A15300); 1× SARS‑CoV‑2 assay with FAM fluor (4332079, assay # APGZJKF); 1× RNaseP assay with VIC fluor (catalog A30064).

steps.title: Add nucleic acids to assay wells
steps.instruction: Using a 96‑well pipettor (Liquidator, Rainin), pipette 5 µL of the extracted nucleic acids into each TaqMan assay well in quadruplicate on the 384‑well plate that already contains the master mixes.

steps.title: Add positive and no‑template controls
steps.instruction: Load positive‑control DNA into two wells for each target and add water to the four no‑template control wells.

substeps.instruction: Add positive‑control DNA to two wells per target.
Add nuclease‑free water to the four no‑template control wells.

steps.title: Seal plate with adhesive film
steps.instruction: Seal the 384‑well plate with a clear adhesive film (Bio‑Rad MSB1001).

steps.title: Run RT‑PCR on QuantStudio 6
steps.instruction: Place the sealed plate in the QuantStudio 6 (Applied Biosystems) and run the RT‑PCR using the Fast setting according to the manufacturer’s instructions.
